segments.sn35.232:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn35.232:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn35.232:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.232:2.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.232:2.2: jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ …pe…
segments.sn35.232:2.3: mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, dhammā manassa saṃyojana”nti?
segments.sn35.232:3.1: “Na kho, āvuso koṭṭhika, cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:3.2: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.232:3.3: na jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:3.4: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.232:3.5: na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:3.6: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, kāḷo ca balībaddo [balivaddo (sī. pī.), balibaddo (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] odāto ca balībaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā assu.
segments.sn35.232:4.3: ‘kāḷo balībaddo odātassa balībaddassa saṃyojanaṃ, odāto balībaddo kāḷassa balībaddassa saṃyojana’nti, sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā”ti?
segments.sn35.232:4.5: “Na kho, āvuso, kāḷo balībaddo odātassa balībaddassa saṃyojanaṃ, na odāto balībaddo kāḷassa balībaddassa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:4.6: Yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:5.1: “Evameva kho, āvuso, na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:5.2: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.232:5.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:5.5: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:6.1: “Cakkhu vā, āvuso, rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ abhavissa, rūpā vā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha [paññāyati (ka.)] sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.232:6.2: Yasmā ca kho, āvuso, na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ;
segments.sn35.232:6.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya…pe….
segments.sn35.232:7.1: “Jivhā, āvuso, rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ abhavissa, rasā vā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.232:7.2: Yasmā ca kho, āvuso, na jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ; yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya…pe….
segments.sn35.232:8.1: “Mano vā, āvuso, dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ abhavissa, dhammā vā manassa saṃyojanaṃ, nayidaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.232:8.2: Yasmā ca kho, āvuso, na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ;
segments.sn35.232:8.3: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.sn35.232:9.1: “Imināpetaṃ, āvuso, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:9.2: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.232:9.4: na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:9.5: Yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:11.1: “Iminā kho etaṃ, āvuso, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ;
segments.sn35.232:11.2: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:11.5: na jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ;
segments.sn35.232:11.6: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn35.232:11.8: na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ;
segments.sn35.232:11.9: yañca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojana”nti.

lines: Parittāti, pabbatamattampi rūpaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ arajanīyaṃ parittaṃ nāma hoti, evarūpāpissa rūpā cittaṃ pariyādiyantīti dasseti.
Ko pana vādo adhimattānanti iṭṭhārammaṇaṃ panassa rajanīyaṃ vatthu cittaṃ pariyādiyatīti ettha kā kathā?
Ettha ca nakhapiṭṭhipamāṇampi maṇimuttādi rajanīyaṃ vatthu adhimattārammaṇamevāti veditabbaṃ.
Sati paccaye vijjamānakiccakaraṇato pariyuṭṭhānaṃ appakaṃ mūsikāvisaṃ viya parittaṃ nāma hoti appānubhāvattā.
Adhimattānanti iṭṭhānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, vatthuvasena parittakampi iṭṭhārammaṇaṃ adhimattameva.
